subject: Wheel bolts, locking bolt and the metal TPMS valve stem, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Move the wheels".

mustShow.text: HERO: Five hex-head wheel bolts per wheel on a 5-lug circle, tightened in a crisscross order. Do NOT depict where its fasteners sit: keep it a plain generic shape.
